From Our Kitchen to Your Table

How missing the taste of home sparked a passion to feed our community.

House of Kayal started with something very simple — our love for food.

Cooking has always been something my boyfriend and I genuinely enjoy. We love talking about food, trying different recipes, getting the spices right, and sitting down together to enjoy a good meal. Even before moving to France, food was always something that brought us comfort and happiness.

After moving here, we started missing the food we grew up with. There were days when all we wanted was a hot chapatti straight from the tawa, a simple homemade curry, or some proper Indian street food.

At the same time, living in Thionville, we noticed how busy everyday life can be — students rushing to class, people travelling to Luxembourg for work, long days and train journeys. Sometimes you simply don't have the time or energy to cook.

That is where the idea for House of Kayal came from. We wanted to create the kind of food we ourselves would love to have: freshly prepared Indian food that feels closer to a home-cooked meal than a typical takeaway.

For those who grew up with Indian food, we hope it brings back a little feeling of home. And for those trying it for the first time, we hope you discover something new to love.

We can't wait for you to take your first bite! ♡
